completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means the repository has a governance-only recursive SOTA audit contract: SHOULD-003 in requirements, the requirements-design-audit loop in design, governance/tooling tests, and explicit gap records for missing current audit outputs. It does not claim a completed current SOTA comparison report, remediation finding list, external benchmark proof, or periodic audit automation.

implemented: recursive SOTA audit requirement in conductor/requirements.md
governance tests for contract and tooling surfaces
explicit gap register for missing current audit outputs
not_implemented: finding list with remediation links and owner tracks

gap_register.description: The track defines the recurring audit contract but does not contain a completed current SOTA audit report, findings baseline, or spawned remediation links.
gap_register.rationale: This archive is closed as a governance-only contract. The actual audit report should be produced by a separate execution track.

gap_register.description: External benchmark or publication proof is not part of this governance contract archive.
gap_register.rationale: External proof belongs to the future SOTA audit execution output, not the contract definition.

description: Periodically compare the repo against SOTA scientific/software project practices, update the project contract, and spawn remediation tracks.
